subject: EVS
learning_goal: Master the chapter content using source-grounded explanations, practice and revision.

sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: In Grade 5, it introduces them to the different features of the larger society and explores the country with its unique beauty and rich diversity.
sections.source_evidence: In Grade 5, it introduces them to the different features of the larger society and explores the country with its unique beauty and rich diversity.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: It indicates how a diverse country stands together with a common goal shared and belief, and demonstrates a meaningful development by setting examples for the world.
sections.source_evidence: It indicates how a diverse country stands together with a common goal shared and belief, and demonstrates a meaningful development by setting examples for the world.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: The traditional Indian belief in ‘Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam’ is reflected in its socio-cultural practices.
sections.source_evidence: The traditional Indian belief in ‘Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam’ is reflected in its socio-cultural practices.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: India is a land of colours, voices and stories, where diverse people, traditions and landscapes come together.
sections.source_evidence: India is a land of colours, voices and stories, where diverse people, traditions and landscapes come together.

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: From school celebrations to coral reefs and mangrove forests, and from currency notes to national symbols — we see how nature, culture and everyday life are deeply connected.
sections.source_evidence: From school celebrations to coral reefs and mangrove forests, and from currency notes to national symbols — we see how nature, culture and everyday life are deeply connected.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: This journey helps us discover the richness around us and the shared care that binds us to our home.
sections.source_evidence: This journey helps us discover the richness around us and the shared care that binds us to our home.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: How to Facilitate • Use the chapter to help students connect their everyday lives to the larger story of India.
sections.source_evidence: How to Facilitate • Use the chapter to help students connect their everyday lives to the larger story of India.

sections.heading: Learning Point 8
sections.content: Encourage them to observe and document local diversity — languages, clothing, festivals and foods. • Encourage students to reflect on what makes their place special, helping them see their home or school as a unique part of India.
sections.source_evidence: Encourage them to observe and document local diversity — languages, clothing, festivals and foods. • Encourage students to reflect on what makes their place special, helping them see their home or school as a unique part of India.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: Visit local parks, markets, rivers, or community spaces to explore the connections between people and nature.
sections.source_evidence: Visit local parks, markets, rivers, or community spaces to explore the connections between people and nature.

sections.heading: Learning Point 10
sections.content: Help children see that their surroundings are also unique, valuable and full of stories. • Discuss why some animals or traditions exist only in certain places. • Help students see how traditional knowledge like using scarecrows to keep birds away reflects smart, non-harmful ways for people in staying safe.
sections.source_evidence: Help children see that their surroundings are also unique, valuable and full of stories. • Discuss why some animals or traditions exist only in certain places. • Help students see how traditional knowledge like using scarecrows to keep birds away reflects smart, non-harmful ways for people in staying safe.

sections.heading: Learning Point 11
sections.content: Encourage them to explore similar examples in their surroundings.
sections.source_evidence: Encourage them to explore similar examples in their surroundings.

sections.heading: Learning Point 12
sections.content: Note to the Teacher This unit consists of two chapters.
sections.source_evidence: Note to the Teacher This unit consists of two chapters.

sections.heading: Learning Point 13
sections.content: It encourages students to understand what makes India unique, while also appreciating the unity and spirit of togetherness that ties it all together.
sections.source_evidence: It encourages students to understand what makes India unique, while also appreciating the unity and spirit of togetherness that ties it all together.

sections.heading: Learning Point 14
sections.content: Through travelling, students explore unique landscapes, rare and endemic species, traditional knowledge, and the deep connection between people and nature.
sections.source_evidence: Through travelling, students explore unique landscapes, rare and endemic species, traditional knowledge, and the deep connection between people and nature.

sections.heading: Learning Point 15
sections.content: The chapter encourages curiosity, care for the environment, and recognition of India’s natural and cultural richness.
sections.source_evidence: The chapter encourages curiosity, care for the environment, and recognition of India’s natural and cultural richness.

sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: A Special Day in School It was 26 January, our Republic Day.
sections.source_evidence: A Special Day in School It was 26 January, our Republic Day.

sections.heading: Learning Point 17
sections.content: We came to school early and all of us gathered around the flagpole in lines.
sections.source_evidence: We came to school early and all of us gathered around the flagpole in lines.

sections.heading: Learning Point 18
sections.content: The ground around the flagpole was beautifully decorated with flowers.
sections.source_evidence: The ground around the flagpole was beautifully decorated with flowers.

sections.heading: Learning Point 19
sections.content: Our head teacher pulled the rope, and our tricolour flag unfurled to the rhythm of drums and claps.
sections.source_evidence: Our head teacher pulled the rope, and our tricolour flag unfurled to the rhythm of drums and claps.

sections.heading: Learning Point 20
sections.content: Together, we sang the National Anthem loudly, with pride and unity.
sections.source_evidence: Together, we sang the National Anthem loudly, with pride and unity.
